quickStart.subtitle: Choose a preset to generate your first AI wallpaper
quickStart.compat1: Tools like Tencent Desktop Organizer or Firefly Wallpaper may occupy the desktop layer
quickStart.compat2: When you apply a video wallpaper, LingScape temporarily hides conflicting overlays and restores them when you stop
quickStart.compat3: Avoid running multiple live wallpaper apps at once; desktop icons are unaffected
